messages:
alex.devex: Filing this here because sampleapp onboarding hit a weird parity issue between SDK and REST. SDK calls include the query param `confirm=false` and the server treats that as a literal string which flips it into a legacy codepath that creates a duplicate onboarding record when a token refresh happens. curl + REST UI don't hit it because they omit the param when false.

maya.sdk: interesting. is the SDK intentionally serializing booleans as strings for query params?

priya.eng: our server expects missing param == false, explicit true == opt-in. receiving 'false' as a string triggers an ancient feature-flag detector that calls the create flow twice if refresh occurs mid-request.

alex.devex: repro (curl works):

```
# curl (server behavior is correct)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/onboard?lang=en" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"name":"acme"}'
```

SDK (typescript) that fails sometimes:

```
// using sdk v1.8.2
await client.onboard({ name: 'acme' }, { query: { lang: 'en', confirm: false } });
```

When SDK includes `confirm=false` the server takes a different branch. If a token refresh happens and the SDK's retry logic retries the POST, we end up with duplicate records.

maya.sdk: That matches a serialization helper we added ages ago: query params go through `String(value)` instead of an omit-for-falsy rule. Also our retry policy currently retries on 401/429/5xx for all methods. We should tighten that.

priya.eng: From the platform side, we can change the server but that risks breaking customers who intentionally rely on literal 'false'. Prefer SDK fix first.

ops-bot: production-alert: two customers reported duplicate onboarding ids in last 24h (ids: ob_1102, ob_1107). Investigating correlation with SDK version v1.8.2.

alex.devex: Proposed immediate steps:
- SDK: omit query param when value is boolean false or null (normalize for both query and headers)
- SDK: change retry behavior to only auto-retry non-POST/PUT methods by default, or require explicit idempotency-key header for mutating retries
- Platform: add a short compatibility middleware to treat literal 'false' the same as missing for the onboarding endpoint while we roll out SDK fix

maya.sdk: I'll put up a small patch to the serializer (omit falsy booleans) and add unit tests for query/header normalization. Also will change retry defaults to not retry POSTs unless idempotency-key present. PR ETA: today EOD.

priya.eng: I'll add the compatibility middleware for onboarding and a short feature-flag to enable it per-tenant, so we don't change global semantics. I'll coordinate with infra to roll it for 24h.

alex.devex: Also we need an integration test in sampleapp pipeline that simulates a token refresh in-flight and ensures no duplicate creates. priya, can you add a stubbed server fixture?

priya.eng: yes, will add a jest fixture that returns 401 on first attempt then 200 on refresh to simulate race, assert single create. ETA tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: ci-status: alex/devex/237000-fix-tests pending, sdk-unit-tests failing on edge-case tests.

maya.sdk: noted, fixing tests now, linking PR when ready: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/489 (draft).

alex.devex: thanks. Once SDK patch merges we'll publish a short note in the quickstart and bump sampleapp dependency.

maya.sdk: adding changelog note about the normalization change and retry behavior.

alex.devex: Summary: root cause = SDK param serialization + broad retry heuristic. Fixes: SDK normalization + conservative retry + temporary server compatibility.

priya.eng: good plan. tagging this P0 for the SDK patch release train.

ops-bot: reminder: please include a migration note in release notes for customers who may see different header/param behavior when updating SDK.
